description_en: Call DescribeChangeOrder to get information about a change order
description_zh: 调用DescribeChangeOrder接口查询变更单信息
name: DescribeChangeOrder

parameters.help_en: The change order ID. You can obtain it by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/126615.html interface
parameters.name: change_order_id

Code.description_en:
The HTTP status code or POP error code. Valid values:

2xx: The request was successful.

3xx: The request was redirected.

4xx: A client-side error occurred.

5xx: A server-side error occurred
Code.description_zh:
接口状态或POP错误码。取值说明如下：

2xx：成功。
3xx：重定向。
4xx：请求错误。
5xx：服务器错误

Data.description_en: The details of the change order

ApplicationEnableGreyTagRoute.description_en: Indicates whether gray tag routing is enabled
ApplicationEnableGreyTagRoute.description_zh: 是否启用灰度标签路由

ApplicationUpdateStrategy.description_en: The update strategy for the application

ApprovalId.description_en: The approval ID for the operation

Auto.description_en:
Indicates whether to automatically release the change in batches. Valid values:

true: The change is automatically released.

false: The change is not automatically released
Auto.description_zh:
是否为自动分批。取值说明如下：

true：自动分批变更。
false：不是自动分批变更

BatchType.description_en:
The release mode for batches. Valid values:

auto: Automatic release.

manual: Manual release
BatchType.description_zh:
分批类型。取值说明如下：

auto：自动。
manual：手动

BatchWaitTime.description_en: The wait time, in minutes, between batches in an automatic release
BatchWaitTime.description_zh: 自动分批方式时，开始下一批次前的等待时间。单位：分钟

CoType.description_en: The change type. This parameter is a description of `CoTypeCode`

CoTypeCode.description_en:
The change type code. Valid values:

CoBindSlb: Binds an SLB instance.

CoUnbindSlb: Unbinds an SLB instance.

CoCreateApp: Creates an application.

CoDeleteApp: Deletes an application.

CoDeploy: Deploys an application.

CoRestartApplication: Restarts an application.

CoRollback: Rolls back an application.

CoScaleIn: Scales in an application.

CoScaleOut: Scales out an application.

CoStart: Starts an application.

CoStop: Stops an application.

CoRescaleApplicationVertically: Modifies instance specifications.

CoDeployHistroy: Rolls back to a historical version.

CoBindNas: Binds a NAS file system.

CoUnbindNas: Unbinds a NAS file system.

CoBatchStartApplication: Starts applications in batches.

CoBatchStopApplication: Stops applications in batches.

CoRestartInstances: Restarts instances.

CoDeleteInstances: Deletes instances.

CoScaleInAppWithInstances: Scales in an application by specifying instances
CoTypeCode.description_zh:
变更类型Code。取值说明如下：

CoBindSlb：绑定SLB。
CoUnbindSlb：解绑SLB。
CoCreateApp：创建应用。
CoDeleteApp：删除应用。
CoDeploy：部署应用。
CoRestartApplication：重启应用。
CoRollback：回滚应用。
CoScaleIn：应用缩容。
CoScaleOut：应用扩容。
CoStart：启动应用。
CoStop：停止应用。
CoRescaleApplicationVertically：修改实例规格。
CoDeployHistroy：回退历史版本。
CoBindNas：绑定NAS。
CoUnbindNas：解绑NAS。
CoBatchStartApplication：批量启动应用。
CoBatchStopApplication：批量停止应用。
CoRestartInstances：重启实例。
CoDeleteInstances：删除实例。
CoScaleInAppWithInstances：指定实例缩容

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the change order was created

CurrentPipelineId.description_en: The ID of the current batch

Description.description_en: The description of the change order

ParallelCount.description_en: The number of parallel tasks in a batch

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the batch

Status.description_en:
The status of the batch. Valid values:

0: Preparing

1: In progress

2: Succeeded

3: Failed

6: Terminated

8: Awaiting manual confirmation

9: Awaiting automatic confirmation

10: Failed due to a system error

11: Pending approval

12: Approved and pending execution
Status.description_zh:
批次状态。取值说明如下：

0：准备。
1：执行中。
2：执行成功。
3：执行失败。
6：终止。
8：等待手工确认分批。
9：等待自动确认分批。
10：系统异常执行失败。
11：等待审批。
12：审批通过，等待执行

UpdateTime.description_en: The time when the batch was last updated

Status.description_en:
The status of the change order. Valid values:

0: Preparing

1: In progress

2: Succeeded

3: Failed

6: Terminated

8: Awaiting manual confirmation

9: Awaiting automatic confirmation

10: Failed due to a system error

11: Pending approval

12: Approved and pending execution
Status.description_zh:
批次状态。取值说明如下：

0：准备。
1：执行中。
2：执行成功。
3：执行失败。
6：终止。
8：等待手工确认分批。
9：等待自动确认分批。
10：系统异常执行失败。
11：等待审批。
12：审批通过，等待执行

SubStatus.description_en:
The substatus of the release order. This parameter indicates whether an exception occurred during the release. Valid values:

0: Normal.

1: Abnormal. For example, if a batch release fails, you must manually perform a rollback, leaving the release order in the In Progress state
SubStatus.description_zh:
发布单子状态，用于判断发布单是否在发布过程中存在异常。取值说明如下：

0：发布正常。
1：发布异常。例如分批发布时出错，需要您手动回滚，此时发布单虽然出错，但因不能完结而依然处于执行中

SupportRollback.description_en:
Indicates whether rollback is supported. Valid values:

true: Rollback is supported.

false: Rollback is not supported
SupportRollback.description_zh:
是否支持回滚。取值说明如下：

true：支持回滚。
false：不支持回滚

ErrorCode.description_en:
The error code.

If the request is successful, this parameter is not returned.

If the request fails, this parameter is returned. For more information, see the error codes section of this topic
ErrorCode.description_zh:
错误码。取值说明如下：

请求成功：不返回ErrorCode字段。
请求失败：返回ErrorCode字段。具体信息，请参见本文的错误码列表

Message.description_en: The message returned for the request

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.

false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
是否成功查询变更单信息。取值说明如下：

true：查询成功。
false：查询失败

TraceId.description_en: The trace ID of the request. This ID is used for troubleshooting
TraceId.description_zh: 调用链ID，用于精确查询调用信息
